formulations.Polymer system Notes: High-molecular-weight PTMC made by bulk ring-opening polymerization of trimethylene carbonate with Sn(Oct)2 at 130 °C for 3 days. Salt is LiTFSI. Sample PTMC2LiTFSI ([carbonate]:[Li+] = 2).
formulations.Notes: Tg is shown only in Fig. 3b, where it rises at high salt content; no value is printed, so Tg is left null. Films were tougher and more 'leathery' than the lower-salt samples. Conductivity–temperature data are shown only in Fig. 2 (VTF behavior, no fit parameters given). The molecular weight appears in the source as 'Mη' 368,000 g/mol (GPC, chloroform), which is taken to mean Mn. Casting solvent was evaporated under N2 for 3 days, then the films were vacuum-dried at 60 °C for 2 days. The Tg of neat PTMC is about -15 °C. There are no melting endotherms, so the material is amorphous.
formulations.Reference: B. Sun, J. Mindemark, K. Edström, D. Brandell, Solid State Ionics (2013), Polycarbonate-based solid polymer electrolytes for Li-ion batteries

formulations.Notes: One of the two most conductive compositions. The text gives conductivity only as an order of magnitude: about 1e-7 S/cm at 60 °C and about 1e-9 S/cm at 25 °C. The electrolyte was used in LFP half-cells (Fig. 6) and cast as coatings on 3D Cu nanopillars. The molecular weight appears in the source as 'Mη' 368,000 g/mol, taken to mean Mn.
